words.definition: the way a person or thing looks.

words.definition: the character and qualities of a person.
words.example: He has a warm personality.

text: Last month, two new colleagues joined our office, Tom and Lucy. Their appearance and personality are very different. Tom is tall and slim — not overweight at all — with short curly hair and a small beard. He doesn't have a moustache. Lucy is short, with long straight hair. Tom's uncle is bald, but Tom still has a lot of hair! In terms of personality, Tom is friendly and confident. He talks to everyone and is never shy. He is also generous — he often brings coffee for the whole team. Lucy is quieter and a little shy at first, but she is honest and kind. She always tells the truth, even when it's difficult. Both of them are hardworking; they never seem lazy, and they finish their work on time. Some new employees can be rude to their colleagues, but Tom and Lucy are polite to everyone. Nobody has ever heard them say an unkind word. The whole team likes them and hopes they will stay at the company for a long time, because good, kind colleagues are hard to find.
